reason: the red-team lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: red-team lens, medium: `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` is exported to true inside the resume branch but is never explicitly cleared (unset or set to false) at the top of `main()`, so a fresh non-resume invocation that inherits `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true` from a prior crashed run or injected environment causes cycle orchestrators to skip to the persisted iteration instead of starting at iter=1, violating GUAR-2. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:2862; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: `_runner_from_stage_preflight` reads `$_runner_issue` from outer scope instead of accepting it as a parameter, while its companion `_runner_resume_rehydrate` takes issue as an explicit `$1`; a test or refactored caller must set the global to exercise this function correctly, and the hidden dependency can silently use the wrong issue if the function is ever called outside the current call site. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1734; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: FSTG-2 requires exit 1 when a pre-target stage has no restorable primary artifact, but `[[ -z "$_fsp_plugin_dir" ]] && continue` and `[[ -z "$_fsp_prim_path" ]] && continue` silently accept stages that have no discoverable plugin or no manifest-defined primary output path, so the preflight check never fires for such stages even when they genuinely have no restored artifact. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1757; fix: code)

red-team lens, medium: When a cycle resumes at the persisted iteration, every stage within that iteration dispatches via `_cycle_dispatch_stage` with iter > 0 and unconditionally emits `stage.start`; stages that completed before the interruption within the same iteration are not skipped, so they re-run, violating RHYD-1 (no stage.start for completed stages) and RESU-2 (outputs byte-identical to interruption state) for within-iteration cycle members. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:2349; fix: code)
